occ.scope: Next-month fire occurrence · {a} · target month {m} · data as of {d}
occ.load_failed: Could not load the probability data. Please try again shortly.

sum.p_label: chance of at least one detection in {m}
sum.persistent: Suspected persistent heat source (factory, gas flare). Excluded from ranking and highlights; value shown for reference only.
sum.industrial: Suspected industrial heat source. Some detections look like factories, so this area is excluded from ranking and highlights; value shown for reference only.
sum.lag1: The previous month is still in progress, so its month-end projection was used as input.
sum.not_area_p: This is not an area-wide probability: it is the distribution of 0.5° cells whose centers fall inside this area.

occ.table_cap: Next-month occurrence probability. Click a header to sort
occ.side_aria: Selected area summary and probability table
occ.csv_aria: Download the occurrence probability table as CSV
occ.top_cells_cap: Top 10 cells excluding suspected persistent sources. Click a cell on the map to inspect it.

val.title: Model validation
val.cap: Trained on earlier years and tested on the following year (grid {g} · municipalities {a}).

how.title: Data and limits
how.target_v: chance of at least one heat detection during {m}
how.model_v: model trained on past detection patterns (XGBoost + probability calibration)
how.input_v: FireBridge harmonized detections (VIIRS S-NPP basis) · total error 1–2%, monthly correlation 0.97
how.grey_kor: suspected industrial municipalities, excluded from ranking
how.grey_world: suspected persistent-source cells, excluded from ranking

occ.limit: Not a weather forecast. These are probabilities from past detection records and recent activity.
occ.more: {m} of {n} rows shown, scroll for more

v12frs.frp_note: FRP from each satellite converted to the S-NPP level. Monthly total of cell-day sums; cells without detections are left blank, not 0. The Terra night ratio is low-confidence.
v12frs.err_wide: Area too large for an FRP summary — narrow it to a country or province

regime_why.large_fire: Large events are ≥ 50% of the month's activity
regime_why.none: Event weight 0 this month · the badge uses detection locations, so it can differ from the calendar value

v12frs.sat_none: No satellite status for this month
v12frs.sat_foot: Monthly totals of satellite × UTC-day status · through {d} · low/missing = days with far fewer or no detections than usual
v12frs.names_foot: Display names are used on screen only. File and response values (method_version · value_source) keep the internal ids. FireBridge was not retrained for v1.2.
v12frs.p_static: v1.2 change · industrial heat sources removed
v12frs.static_rule: Points in always-hot 0.01° cells (steel works, petrochemical and cement plants, gas flares — static sources in ≥ 2 years) are removed from all totals, for SP and NRT alike. Share removed from area monthly values:
v12frs.static_foot: Before 2012-02 (MODIS period) only part is removed: the model estimate that cannot be split by point stays.
v12frs.frp_rule: FRP (S-NPP equivalent) = satellite FRP ÷ ratio. The ratio is the median Σ FRP ratio over 0.1° cell-local days detected by both the satellite and S-NPP. Comparison years Aqua 2012–2025 · Terra 2012–2019 · NOAA-20 2018–2025 · NOAA-21 2024–2025.
v12frs.frp_limit: * The Terra night ratio is low-confidence (its night pass is about 3 hours earlier than S-NPP's). 2000–2011 MODIS uses the post-2012 ratios (assumption).

err.range_too_large: Area too large to fetch at once (server limit 100 sq. deg) — narrow the region
err.rate_limited: Too many requests — try again shortly

fwi.label: Fire weather
fwi.title: Fire weather index (Canadian FWI) {v} · vs normal: {rel} · absolute class: {abs} · {d} (NASA POWER daily data, about 4 days behind). Weather-based danger only; it does not predict ignition or spread

nowcast.title: Next-day spread chance

nowcast.error: Could not load spread chance data
nowcast.tip_cand: Candidate cell (within about 7.5 km of today's detections)
nowcast.notice: Short-term spread chance from satellite detections. Not a physical simulation; spread beyond about 7.5 km from today's detections and new ignitions are not predicted.

real.pts_wide: Area too large to draw detections — narrow the region
real.no_occur: Real data has no ignition time; only satellite overpass time is used
real.val: Adopted model, Korea monthly total MAE {mae} · bias {bias}

burn.label: Satellite-confirmed burned area (lower bound)

events.src: Detections linked in space and time (VIIRS ≤750 m · MODIS ≤2 km · 1 day) — release fire_events

land.no_parcels: Satellite events have no parcel data — parcels exist only for agency (example) fires
